name: API Demo
description: Reference plugin for the [api_endpoints] capability. Answers read-only questions about the playlist a login unlocks and shows the SSRF-guarded fetch helper.

api_endpoints.label: Playlist summary
api_endpoints.description: Returns the name and type of the playlist the login unlocks.

api_endpoints.label: Echo
api_endpoints.description: Echoes a validated message, for testing API clients.

api_endpoints.label: URL status
api_endpoints.description: Fetches a caller-supplied URL through the host SSRF guard and returns only its HTTP status.
